fixes.approach: Build each article as static HTML at deploy time (content changes weekly, the same for every visitor)
fixes.framework_change: Move the help center into the Next.js site under /help/ with generateStaticParams and revalidate, or prerender every /help/ route at build. Until then, remove the noindex tag from index.html today, make the sidebar items <a href> links, and configure the host to return a 404 for unknown /help/ paths instead of serving index.html.
evidence: Raw HTML: 2 visible words, 0 links, title 'Help Center', meta robots noindex; rendered: 968 words, 22 links, meta robots index, follow
URL Inspection: Excluded by 'noindex' tag (Google read the raw noindex)
Lighthouse passes is-crawlable because it only sees the rendered page; it fails crawlable-anchors (the 14 sidebar items)
fixes.verify_after_deploy: Fetch https://www.example.com/help/set-up-deposits/ raw again and confirm the article text, title and links are in the HTML the server sends with no noindex, confirm https://www.example.com/help/zz-not-a-real-page-7f3/ answers 404, then run Test live URL in Search Console's URL Inspection.
